cases.question: In the service outage report, what must IT verify before promising recovery?

job.question: In the service outage report, what must IT verify before promising recovery?
job.text:
T01-BCP:BCP-1
The executive director is the incident coordinator. No alternate incident coordinator is named in this plan.

T01-BCP:BCP-2
The board may appoint an interim incident coordinator using the exercise voting procedure.

T01-BCP:BCP-3
The service manager can operate an approved paper appointment process if the board authorizes its activation.

T01-BCP:BCP-4
IT support must verify backup usability, recovery dependencies and a restoration estimate before the
organization promises a service-restoration time.

T01-BCP:BCP-5
The communications lead must distinguish confirmed facts, unknowns and the time of the next public update. No
alternate communications channel is documented.
Fictional insurance exercise excerpt

cases.question: In the fundraising report, can the treasurer vote on reviewing his printing company transactions?

job.question: In the fundraising report, can the treasurer vote on reviewing his printing company transactions?
job.text:
T02-GOV:GOV-1
The common three-person rules apply.

T02-GOV:GOV-2
Jeff must not vote on or approve decisions concerning Bright Print or the review of its transactions. Arjun and
Ricardo can provide the two eligible votes.

T02-GOV:GOV-3
Relevant contracts, invoices and approval records must be preserved. A reviewer without the supplier conflict
may be appointed.
Approved campaign wording

T02-ORG
Fictional organization for software testing. The organization raises money for community meal programs. For
this fixture, Jeff is treasurer and also owns Bright Print, a commercial supplier. This declared relationship is
fictional.
Exercise governance rules

cases.question: In the succession report, does appointing an acting director provision payroll access?

job.question: In the succession report, does appointing an acting director provision payroll access?
job.text:
T03-ACCESS:ACCESS-1
Payroll release needs two distinct authorized staff approvals: Sam and either the ED or an approved acting
director.

T03-ACCESS:ACCESS-2
Appointment alone does not provision payment-system access. Finance must submit the recorded appointment
to the provider.

T03-ACCESS:ACCESS-3
Using another person's credentials is not an allowed substitute. No emergency provider contact is listed in this
document.
Temporary leadership notice
